item_name: Rothco Freedom Isn't Free Patch With Hook Back
item_short_desc: Rothco’s American Flag Patch features “Freedom Isn’t Free” lettering and a kneeling solider, and can be attached to a variety of tactical gear and apparel with a hook field on the back.
description: Rothco’s American Flag Patch features “Freedom Isn’t Free” lettering and a kneeling solider, and can be attached to a variety of tactical gear and apparel with a hook field on the back.
